question: Does the large P1 error of the latest shared fields mainly remain after removing a descriptive whole-affine displacement error, and is it concentrated in small physical cells rather than explained only by the relative-error denominator?

selection.policy: Exactly the intersection of the two already-exported representative indexes; determined from small JSON before reading arrays

scope.cache_reference: Only the tor slice of the existing three-known-load TRAIN cache is used; no new target construction or scaler fitting

compute.device: Prefer CUDA tensor reductions/physical cell arithmetic and incident-node scatter if available; one bounded diagnostic process without native models, gradients or optimizer
compute.fallback: CPU for this small fixed diagnostic only, recorded explicitly
compute.dtype: float64 physical arithmetic; existing normalized xyz and signed u fields unchanged

formulas.error: e=u_pred_mm-u_true_mm; preserve all signed XYZ components
formulas.affine_fit: Equal-node least squares of e on [1, xyz_normalized-mean(xyz_normalized)], four predictors and three components; fit only as a descriptive GT-dependent oracle, never a deployable correction or model input
formulas.residual: e_res=e-e_aff; report physical vector RMS and unweighted node energies of raw/affine/residual and 2*cross separately
formulas.cell_P1: Existing frozen cell_tensor_strain(corner_values, inverse_physical_edge_mm); symmetric tensor order xx,yy,zz,xy,xz,yz, Frobenius weights1,1,1,2,2,2
formulas.error_P1: Apply the same linear P1 operator to raw/affine/residual errors; raw must equal affine+residual numerically
formulas.all_node_P1: Existing frozen recover_node_tensor_strain with physical positive volumes and original cells10; same operator for reference and error components
formulas.energy_identity: E_raw=E_aff+E_res+2<aff,res> for displacement, volume-weighted cell strain and all-node strain; retain signed cross term, do not falsely add only squared energies
formulas.denominators: Report physical u RMS/error RMS in mm, dimensionless P1 Frobenius reference/error RMS, and both original relative errors; relativeP1/relativeu is descriptive, not a frequency or causal proof
formulas.matching: Stored sample_key/step/signed-u/xyz order must match both indexes; GT and xyz must match exactly between fields; recovered raw relativeu/P1 must reproduce same-case metrics_best within stated numerical tolerance

geometry_bins.source: Input-only fixed cache inverse physical edge matrix and absolute cell volume; no GT or prediction used to choose bins
geometry_bins.minimum_corner_edge: Invert cached inverse matrix to three physical corner edges; take minimum length of the six tetra corner edges
geometry_bins.edges: For each of these two measures, once compute unweighted input-cell quantiles0,.25,.5,.75,1; use same bins for both models, handle ties deterministically
geometry_bins.report: Per bin cell-count/physical-volume shares and raw/residual/GT volume-weighted P1 energies, plus signed affine-residual cross terms; no posthoc subcase or cutoffs
geometry_bins.limit: Short-cell concentration does not alone prove high-frequency Hash oscillations; geometry, inverse-edge conditioning and true concentration can also amplify gradients

predeclared_readout.non_affine_dominance_flag: Both models retain at least80% of raw all-node P1 error energy after removing the fitted affine error; a descriptive signature only
predeclared_readout.small_cell_concentration_flag: Smallest input-h quartile contains at least50% of residual volume-weighted cell-P1 error energy and at least2 times its physical-volume share; compare against GT concentration, do not infer cause
predeclared_readout.if_non_affine_dominant: Consider exactly one predeclared spatial-bandwidth representation control, informed by physical RMS and geometry bins, with a fresh matched baseline and unchanged loss/selection; no automatic cutoff sweep
predeclared_readout.otherwise: Prioritize one geometry/BC whole-deformation hypothesis supported by the measured affine/denominator/error terms instead of a high-frequency claim

limits: One already-selected worst-TRAIN representative common to both models, not a random cohort or all-validation result.
The two fields are fixed latest u-selected10000 checkpoints; no comparison against older native capacities or models.
GT-dependent affine subtraction is an oracle description of error, not boundary enforcement, an improved prediction or deployable method.
P1 is the existing corner finite-element proxy recovered to all original nodes, not solver strain GT or exact quadratic element strain.
Energy removal ratios with nonzero strain cross terms are not independent causal contributions.
No significance, final-test generalization, solver stiffness, remeshing invariance or innovation claim.
